cn2.text: Rashmi builds a matter transporter around her aether condenser for the Inventors' Fair, but the trials fail, with flowers disintegrating or imploding until the filament snaps on the 887th.

Mitul points out that a vase has been transported across the room, confirming that they moved inorganic matter across space, but with no spare filament in all of Ghirapur Rashmi heartbrokenly tells Mitul they must close the inquirium.

Saheeli finds Rashmi and refuses to help at first, saying the device is too dangerous, and Rashmi accuses her of jealousy, but Saheeli returns with a new filament and the transporter moves the vase across the room.
Rashmi learns that Saheeli bought Padeem's audience with a front-row duel seat, so the two reconcile and Rashmi and Mitul present the transporter to Padeem, who tells Rashmi to impress her.
